dtr.en: Fears of damaging ecosystems are based on the sound conservationist principle that we should aim to minimize the disruption we cause, but there is a risk that this principle may be confused with the old idea of a 'balance of nature.'
dtr.ko: 생태계를 훼손하는 것에 대한 두려움은 우리가 일으키는 교란을 최소화하는 것을 목표로 해야 한다는 타당한 자연 보호론자의 원칙에 근거하지만, 이 원칙이 '자연의 균형'이라는 오래된 개념과 혼동될 수 있다는 위험이 있다.
pt: principle that ~ / risk that ~ = 동격 that절 2개
the disruption (that) we cause = 목적격 관계대명사 생략
be confused with ~ = ~와 혼동되다 · of = 동격(~이라는)

rows.pt: 주어 Fears, of + 동명사 damaging = ~하는 것에 대한

rows.w: are based on the sound conservationist principle
koAlt: 타당한 자연 보호론적 원칙에 바탕을 둔다
타당한 자연 보호론자의 원칙에 근거하고 있다
rows.pt: 동사 are based on = ~에 근거하다, sound = 타당한(소리 X)

rows.w: that we should aim to minimize the disruption we cause,
rows.ko: 우리가 일으키는 교란을 최소화하는 것을 목표로 해야 한다는
koAlt: 우리가 일으키는 교란을 최소화하도록 노력해야 한다는
우리가 초래하는 방해를 최소화하는 것을 목표로 해야 한다는
우리가 일으키는 교란을 최소화하는 것을 목표로 해야 한다
우리가 만드는 교란을 최소화하는 것을 목표로 삼아야 한다는
우리가 일으키는 방해를 줄이는 것을 목표로 해야 한다는
rows.pt: 동격 that절(principle = that ~), the disruption (that) we cause = 목적격 관계대명사 생략

rows.w: that this principle may be confused with
rows.pt: 동격 that절(risk = that ~), be confused with = ~와 혼동되다

rows.w: the old idea of a 'balance of nature.'

dtr.en: Ecosystems are dynamic, and although some may endure, apparently unchanged, for periods that are long in comparison with the human lifespan, they must and do change eventually.
dtr.ko: 생태계는 역동적이며, 비록 일부는 인간의 수명과 비교하여 긴 기간 동안 겉보기에 변하지 않은 채로 지속될 수도 있지만, 그것들은 결국 변해야 하고 실제로 변한다.
pt: although ~ lifespan, = 문장 중간에 끼어든 양보절
apparently unchanged = 삽입된 분사 · periods that are long = 주격 관계대명사
must and do change = 조동사 병렬 · do = 강조

rows.pt: 주어 Ecosystems, 동사 are, 보어 dynamic

rows.ko: 그리고 비록 일부는 지속될 수도 있지만
koAlt: 그리고 비록 어떤 것들은 지속될 수 있지만
그리고 몇몇은 오래 지속될 수도 있지만
그리고 어떤 것은 견딜 수도 있지만
rows.pt: although = 비록 ~이지만 (양보 접속사), some = some ecosystems
삽입된 분사 unchanged = 변하지 않은 채로

rows.w: in comparison with the human lifespan,
they must and do change eventually.
rows.ko: 그것들은 결국 변해야 하고 실제로 변한다
koAlt: 그것들은 결국 변해야만 하고 실제로 변한다
결국 그것들은 반드시 변하고 실제로 변한다
그것들은 결국 변할 수밖에 없고 실제로 변한다
생태계는 결국 변해야 하고 정말로 변한다
그것들은 결국 반드시 변하며 실제로 변한다
그것들은 결국 변해야 하며 실제로 변한다
rows.pt: must and do change = 조동사 병렬, do = 강조(실제로, 정말로)

dtg.b:
전치사냐 접속사냐는 뜻으로 고르지 말고 바로 뒤에 오는 모양을 먼저 봐요.
접속사 + 주어 + 동사 (절)
전치사 + 명사(구) / 동명사 / what절
dtg.ex:
because of there is no functional separation ✘ → there is는 절 → because ✔
despite I live thousands of miles away ✘ → even though ✔

dtg.b:
뜻은 같은데 품사가 다른 짝이에요.

· ~에도 불구하고: although / though / even though (접속사) ↔ despite / in spite of (전치사)
· ~ 때문에: because / now that (접속사) ↔ because of / due to (전치사)
· ~ 동안: while (접속사) ↔ during (전치사)
· ~할 경우에 대비해: in case (접속사) ↔ in case of (전치사)
dtg.ex:
While World War II ✘ → During World War II ✔
In case of emergency ✔ / in case it rains ✔

dtg.h: 함정 ① 뒤에 붙은 관계절에 속지 않기
dtg.b: 명사 뒤에 who·that절이 붙어 있어도, 밑줄 단어의 짝은 그 명사까지예요.
dtg.ex:
While World War II, there was a group of people who risked …
→ While 뒤는 World War II(명사)까지 → During

dtg.b: 명사 뒤에 that + 주어 + 동사가 붙으면 그 명사를 꾸미는 관계절이에요. 주어+동사처럼 보여도 꾸밈말이라, 밑줄 단어 뒤는 통째로 명사구예요.
dtg.ex:
While the three hours that the debate lasted, … ✘
→ the three hours [that the debate lasted] = 명사구 → During ✔

dtg.b: 전치사 뒤에 동사는 못 오지만 -ing(동명사)와 what절(명사절)은 올 수 있어요. 둘 다 명사 역할이라서요.
dtg.ex:
despite officially retaining the death penalty ✔ (동명사)
due to what Alvaro Bilbao, a neuropsychologist, calls … ✔ (what절)

dtg.b: while 뒤에 주어+be동사가 생략되고 -ing만 남을 수 있어요(맞는 문장). during + -ing는 안 써요.
dtg.ex:
notice the obvious aspects of a new medium while missing the more subtle aspects ✔
… during missing the more subtle aspects ✘

dtg.b: 전치사 뒤에 절을 쓰고 싶으면 the fact that + 절로 명사구를 만들어요.
dtg.ex: In spite of the fact that he lacked experience ✔

dtg.b:
so + 형용사/부사 + that
such + (a) + 형용사 + 명사 + that
so that + 절 = ~하도록(목적)
dtg.ex:
such heavy ✘ → so heavy ✔ (명사 없음)
so a wonderful experience ✘ → such a wonderful experience ✔

dtg.b:
모두 뒤에 주어 + 동사가 와요.
· now that = ~이므로
· in that = ~라는 점에서
· given that = ~을 고려하면
· as long as = ~하는 한
dtg.ex:
Despite she had never studied Spanish ✘ → Given that she had … ✔
in case of you drive carefully ✘ → as long as you drive ✔

dtg.b: given과 considering은 바로 명사를 받아요. of를 붙이지 않아요.
dtg.ex: Considering of his age ✘ → Given his age ✔

dtg.b: 재시에서 X 문장은 왜 틀렸는지도 써야 해요. 뒤가 절인지 명사구인지를 짧게 쓰면 돼요.
dtg.ex:
✔ 뒤에 주어+동사(절)가 와서 전치사 말고 접속사
✔ 뒤에 명사구라 접속사 말고 전치사
✘ 틀려서 / Although로 바꿔야 함 (이유 없음)

dtgx.w: In certain areas of the world, even basic light microscopes are not accessible because their cost.
dtgx.en: In certain areas of the world, even basic light microscopes are not accessible because their cost.
dtgx.ex: 뒤에 their cost = 명사구 → 접속사 because를 전치사 because of로

dtgx.w: While World War II, there was a group of people who risked everything to protect priceless works of art from ruin.
dtgx.en: While World War II, there was a group of people who risked everything to protect priceless works of art from ruin.
dtgx.ex: 뒤에 World War II = 명사(구)뿐 → 접속사 While을 전치사 During으로 (뒤의 who절에 속지 않기)

dtgx.w: English has become a widely used lingua franca due to its extensive usage in many countries.
dtgx.en: English has become a widely used lingua franca due to its extensive usage in many countries.
dtgx.ex: due to + 명사구(its extensive usage ~) — 맞는 문장

dtgx.w: Take an umbrella in case it rains this afternoon.
dtgx.en: Take an umbrella in case it rains this afternoon.
dtgx.ex: in case + 절(it rains ~) = ~할 경우에 대비해 — 맞는 문장

dtgx.w: Nobody was allowed to use a phone during the interview.
dtgx.en: Nobody was allowed to use a phone during the interview.
dtgx.ex: during + 명사구(the interview) — 맞는 문장

dtgx.w: In case of emergency, press the red button next to the door.
dtgx.en: In case of emergency, press the red button next to the door.
dtgx.ex: in case of + 명사(emergency) — 전치사 — 맞는 문장

dtgx.w: Keep the receipt in case you need to return the shoes.
dtgx.en: Keep the receipt in case you need to return the shoes.
dtgx.ex: in case + 절(you need ~) — 접속사 — 맞는 문장

dtgx.w: Despite we are separated by a great distance, we share the same planet.
dtgx.en: Despite we are separated by a great distance, we share the same planet.
dtgx.ex: 뒤에 we are separated ~ = 절 → 전치사 Despite를 접속사 Although로

dtgx.w: The museum stayed closed while the renovation.
dtgx.en: The museum stayed closed while the renovation.
dtgx.ex: 뒤에 the renovation = 명사구 → 접속사 while을 전치사 during으로

dtgx.w: Because of the heavy rain, the game was canceled.
dtgx.en: Because of the heavy rain, the game was canceled.
dtgx.ex: Because of + 명사구(the heavy rain) — 맞는 문장

dtgx.w: Despite she was exhausted, she finished the report on time.
dtgx.en: Despite she was exhausted, she finished the report on time.
dtgx.ex: 뒤에 she was exhausted = 절 → Despite를 Although로 (또는 Despite being exhausted)

dtgx.w: While his stay in London, he visited the British Museum twice.
dtgx.en: While his stay in London, he visited the British Museum twice.
dtgx.ex: 뒤에 his stay in London = 명사구(stay는 명사) → While을 During으로

dtgx.w: In spite of the fact that he lacked experience, he got the job.
dtgx.en: In spite of the fact that he lacked experience, he got the job.
dtgx.ex: In spite of + the fact(명사) + that절(동격) — 맞는 문장

dtgx.w: Bring a jacket in case of it gets cold at night.
dtgx.en: Bring a jacket in case of it gets cold at night.
dtgx.ex: 뒤에 it gets cold = 절 → 전치사 in case of를 접속사 in case로

dtgx.w: Although his poor eyesight, he became one of the greatest painters of his time.
dtgx.en: Although his poor eyesight, he became one of the greatest painters of his time.
dtgx.ex: 뒤에 his poor eyesight = 명사구 → 접속사 Although를 전치사 Despite로

dtgx.w: She practiced the speech every night so that she could win the contest.
dtgx.en: She practiced the speech every night so that she could win the contest.
dtgx.ex: so that + 절 = ~하도록(목적) — 맞는 문장

dtgx.w: It was such a hot day that we decided to stay indoors.
dtgx.en: It was such a hot day that we decided to stay indoors.
dtgx.ex: such + a + 형용사 + 명사 + that — 맞는 문장

dtgx.w: The box was such heavy that nobody could lift it alone.
dtgx.en: The box was such heavy that nobody could lift it alone.
dtgx.ex: 뒤에 명사 없이 형용사(heavy)만 → so + 형용사 + that → such를 so로

dtgx.w: Mina had such a busy schedule this semester that she rarely had time to rest.
dtgx.en: Mina had such a busy schedule this semester that she rarely had time to rest.
dtgx.ex: such + a + 형용사 + 명사 + that — 맞는 문장

dtgx.w: Now that her final exams are over, she has decided to take a short trip alone.
dtgx.en: Now that her final exams are over, she has decided to take a short trip alone.
dtgx.ex: now that + 절 = ~이므로(이유 접속사) — 맞는 문장

dtgx.w: The trip turned out to be so a wonderful experience that she wants to go again next year.
dtgx.en: The trip turned out to be so a wonderful experience that she wants to go again next year.
dtgx.ex: a + 형용사 + 명사 앞 → such a wonderful experience (또는 so wonderful an experience)

dtgx.w: It was also meaningful in that it taught her how to be independent.
dtgx.en: It was also meaningful in that it taught her how to be independent.
dtgx.ex: in that + 절 = ~라는 점에서 — 맞는 문장

dtgx.w: Given his age, he is surprisingly mature.
dtgx.en: Given his age, he is surprisingly mature.
dtgx.ex: Given + 명사 = ~을 고려하면 (Considering of는 틀림) — 맞는 문장

dtgx.w: You may use my car in case of you drive carefully.
dtgx.en: You may use my car in case of you drive carefully.
dtgx.ex: 뒤에 you drive ~ = 절 → 전치사 in case of 불가 → 접속사 as long as로

dtgx.w: Despite she had never studied Spanish, her pronunciation was impressive.
dtgx.en: Despite she had never studied Spanish, her pronunciation was impressive.
dtgx.ex: 뒤에 she had never studied ~ = 절 → 전치사 Despite 불가 → Given that(Although)으로

dtgx.w: The movie was so touching that everyone in the theater cried.
dtgx.en: The movie was so touching that everyone in the theater cried.
dtgx.ex: so + 형용사 + that — 맞는 문장

dtg.tag: D 어법 전치사 vs 접속사 · 기출 가장 어려운 6문장

rows.w: Ishii describes this as seamless communication because of there is no functional separation between the task and communication space.
rows.en: Ishii describes this as seamless communication because of there is no functional separation between the task and communication space.
rows.ex: 뒤에 there is ~ = 주어+동사 절 → 전치사 because of를 접속사 because로

rows.w: Punishing a child may not be effective due to what Alvaro Bilbao, a neuropsychologist, calls 'trick-punishments.'
rows.en: Punishing a child may not be effective due to what Alvaro Bilbao, a neuropsychologist, calls 'trick-punishments.'
rows.ex: due to + what절 — what절은 명사절이라 전치사 뒤에 올 수 있음 (a neuropsychologist는 삽입된 동격) — 맞는 문장

rows.w: Most of us notice the obvious aspects of a new medium during missing the more subtle aspects.
rows.en: Most of us notice the obvious aspects of a new medium during missing the more subtle aspects.
rows.ex: while missing = while (we are) missing — 접속사 뒤 주어+be 생략은 되지만 during + -ing는 쓰지 않음 → during을 while로

rows.w: Twenty-one countries, despite officially retaining the death penalty, never enforce it.
rows.en: Twenty-one countries, despite officially retaining the death penalty, never enforce it.
rows.ex: despite + 동명사(officially retaining ~) — 전치사 뒤 동명사는 명사 역할이라 맞음 — 맞는 문장

rows.w: When I read about this wonderful project, I was inspired to write to you, despite I live thousands of miles away.
rows.en: When I read about this wonderful project, I was inspired to write to you, despite I live thousands of miles away.
rows.ex: 뒤에 I live ~ = 주어+동사 절 → 전치사 despite를 접속사 even though(although)로

rows.w: While the three hours that the debate lasted, neither candidate mentioned the budget even once.
rows.en: While the three hours that the debate lasted, neither candidate mentioned the budget even once.
rows.ex: that the debate lasted는 앞의 hours를 꾸미는 관계절(주어+동사처럼 보이지만 꾸밈말) → While 뒤는 명사구(the three hours) → 접속사 While을 전치사 During으로
